title: ClassGraph Stage 1 Frame
description: One record per processed video frame. Emitted as JSONL — one JSON object per line.

frame_id.description: Zero-indexed frame index in the source video.

timestamp_ms.description: Frame presentation time in milliseconds from video start.

persons.description: Detected students. Empty array if none detected.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned pixel bbox [x, y, w, h] with (x, y) as top-left.

track_id.description: Stable ID from Stage 2 tracker. Always null in Stage 1 output.

posture.description: Raw body-pose geometry (backend/posture.py). NOT a posture or engagement classification -- see that module's docstring for why a bowed/upright label was tried and rejected as unvalidated. null when MediaPipe Pose found no body in the person's crop.

vertical_lean.description: nose.y - shoulder_mid.y, normalised by crop height. A raw feature, not a validated bowed/upright signal.

facing_direction.description: Unit vector perpendicular to the shoulder line. Sign is an UNCONFIRMED guess -- real-image validation was inconclusive given this project's camera angle. Do not rely on its sign.

source.description: How this student was found. "yolo" = the body was detected directly and bbox is a real detection. "face_seeded" = only the face was detected (YOLO missed the occluded body) and bbox is ESTIMATED from face geometry, not measured. See backend/students.py.

expression.description: Visible facial EXPRESSION, not an inferred emotional state. null when no face was found or the face was too small to classify honestly (see backend/expression.py). Report class-level aggregates by default, never a live per-student label.

label.description: Mapped from the model raw 8-class output; see distribution. "uncertain" means the prediction fell below ExpressionConfig.min_confidence and was deliberately NOT forced into one of the three reported labels -- abstention, not an error. Measured on real classroom faces, ~55% of predictions land here, so treating "uncertain" as a failure would discard the majority of honest output.

confidence.description: Probability of the winning RAW class, not of the mapped bucket.

distribution.description: Full raw 8-class AffectNet distribution, so the 8-to-3 collapse stays auditable.

behaviour.description: What this student is doing, from the fine-tuned behaviour model (backend/behaviour.py). null when no behaviour box bound to this student, when the prediction was a class the model is not trusted for, or when the fine-tuned weights are absent. Classes handrise/stand are never reported (F1 4.1% and 0.0% held out) and turn_head/look_forward are deferred to head pose, which measures them better (F1 63.2% vs 25.0%).

label.description: The behaviour class. Only classes this model is the best available owner of.

reliability.description: How much this class can be trusted, carried WITH the value so a weak signal cannot be read as a strong one. "weak" means poor held-out recall -- using_device reaches only ~20%. Consumers must respect this rather than treating all labels alike.

person_id.description: Stable, re-identified person id for THIS video only (see backend/identity.py), distinct from track_id. Unlike track_id, this is intended to stay the same for one physical student across brief full occlusion or leaving-and-re-entering frame, as long as their face is seen again -- recovered by matching a face embedding against faces already seen earlier in this same video. null when track_id is null. A NEGATIVE value marks a person minted without ever being matched by face (no trustworthy face was available for them) -- distinguished from a real gallery id (>=1) so a consumer never mistakes an unverified id for a re-identified one. Never persisted or reused across different videos.
